title: No owning service per agent in the agent catalog
source: Recovery Workbench Agent Catalog and Specifications v2.xlsx
description: The 12 agents of v2 are described by behaviour only. No sheet gives a service, an API, a topic or a schema for an agent, and no legacy story key exists for an agent. Architecture v5 names an agent child workflow only for P5 (classify / extract), S8 (screening) and S1 (route). The Ownership Map v1 places the agent tables, the /admin/agent-* endpoints and AgentRunWorkflow under P10 rwb-agent only, which is the runtime host and not the business owner.
evidence: Agent Catalog v2.xlsx sheet Agents (Agent, Watches, Does, Inputs, May call, May decide alone, Escalates, Measured on, Live, Shadow from) and sheet Decision steps (column Run by); Ownership Map v1 sheet Tables (agent_alert to agent_sample, owner P10), sheet Endpoints (GET /admin/agent-runs and 10 more, owner P10), sheet Workflows and activities (AgentRunWorkflow, owner P10); Architecture v5 Text Extract v1 slides 15, 16 and 18; split_plan.json legacy has no agent key
owner_role: Solution architect with the agent platform owner
proposed: Record one owning service per agent in the new Agents v3 sheet, read as the business service whose decision steps the agent serves, plus P10 rwb-agent as the runtime host of all 12 agents; tag the owning service on the agent stories and the contract dependencies.

title: Owning service of the Valuation agent is not named
source: Recovery Workbench Agent Catalog and Specifications v2.xlsx
description: Decision step D6.1 (Accept the appraisal value) is run by the Valuation agent and first appears in E3. No service contract or FSD feature names a valuation agent child: Architecture v5 slide 18 gives S1 rwb-valuation the valuations, the D6 route decision and the route agent output, and FSD S1 covers D6 with the route agent only. The owning service is therefore read as S1 from the appraisal and valuation domain, not from a named agent call.
evidence: Agent Catalog v2.xlsx sheet Decision steps row D6.1 (Run by Valuation agent, First in E3); Architecture v5 Text Extract v1 slide 18 and its notes (S1 rwb-valuation: valuations, D6 route decision, route agent output); FSD S1 Valuation and route v3 (Feature scope: D6 route decision with COLLINS return by route and the route agent); Ownership Map v1 sheet Endpoints (POST /cases/{caseId}/route, owner S1)
owner_role: Solution architect with the valuation and route module owner
proposed: Assign the Valuation agent to S1 rwb-valuation, the owner of appraisals and valuations, and build its run as an S1 activity of RouteDecisionWorkflow if it is built; do not assign it to P3 rwb-case or P7 rwb-decision.

title: Owning service of the Tracing agent is not named
source: Recovery Workbench Agent Catalog and Specifications v2.xlsx
description: The Tracing agent serves X6 (trace a lost customer) and D7.5 (enforce: trace, writ, seizure, auction). Its inputs span contact points, the interaction ledger and partner results, which reach P1 rwb-source-data, P3 rwb-case and S9 rwb-partner. Decision step D7.5 runs in Partner mode with the tracing agent and the law firm, and no source names the service that owns the agent.
evidence: Agent Catalog v2.xlsx sheet Decision steps rows X6 and D7.5 (Run by Tracing agent, Mode Partner); sheet Agents row Tracing agent (May call: read case; request trace from partner; propose contact update); Architecture v5 Text Extract v1 slide 17 and its notes (S9 rwb-partner: InstructionWorkflow, Act: issueInstruction, Act: recordResult; partner portal) and slide 41 (P1 owns contact_point_ext); FSD S9 FEAT-PRM-05 (receive a partner result into the case)
owner_role: Solution architect with the partner management owner
proposed: Assign the Tracing agent to S9 rwb-partner because every action outside the case read is a partner trace instruction; record that P1 rwb-source-data owns the contact points the agent proposes to update and that P3 rwb-case owns the case read.

title: Agent catalog v2 records no status or approval
source: Recovery Workbench Agent Catalog and Specifications v2.xlsx
description: The workbook has no status row, no approval record and no version or change-log row. D-RCV-60 issues the next version of the family with no approval recorded, so the version carries Status Draft and the change-log row that Template and Rules R8.1 requires.
evidence: Agent Catalog v2.xlsx sheets Agents and Decision steps (no status, approval, version or change-log row); Template and Rules v1 section R8.1 (header and change-log row) and section R8.2 (next version)
owner_role: Document owner with the strategy and model committee secretariat
proposed: Issue v3 with Status Draft and the change-log row v3, 22 November 2026, D-RCV-60 microservice realignment; claim no approval and leave the approval to the verification loop that follows this run.
